CRON_DESC: Explain a cron expression and list its next runs
CRON_EXPRESSION: Five fields or a macro, like 30 9 * * MON-FRI or @daily
CRON_TIMEZONE: Timezone for the runs; yours when empty
CRON_SEND: Send the explanation to the channel
ON_MONTH_DAYS_OR_WEEKDAYS: on day {days} of the month or on {weekdays}
NO_RUNS: It never runs in the next eight years.
FIELD_COUNT: A cron expression has five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month and weekday.
BAD_FIELD: "{field}" isn't a valid cron field here.
UNKNOWN_MACRO: {field} isn't a cron macro. Try @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly or @yearly.
BAD_TIMEZONE: "{timezone}" isn't a timezone. Use a name like Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
